note: Knowledge-group decisions over m49-regions.json, as data: a country or area that a page groups by M49 sub-region in another sub-region than the UN's, with the reason. An entry applies only when, among the places a page groups, the country would otherwise be the only one of its own M49 sub-region (when_alone): with others of that sub-region beside it the UN's grouping stands. A page that moves a country says so in its notes (the move is handed on with the groups: the country, the UN's sub-region and the one it was placed in). Read by next_knowledge.rs (M49Groups) only.

overrides.reason: Cyprus is an EU member state that M49 places in Western Asia; a page grouping EU members by European sub-region places it with Southern Europe and says so (decided 2026-11-23).
